question.t: 在 Code Review 中，你發現了上述程式碼。除了語意不明確之外，使用 `div` 代替原生 `<button>` 會導致哪些具體的無障礙功能缺失？
question.en: During a Code Review, you encountered the code snippet above. Besides unclear semantics, what specific accessibility features are lost by using a `div` instead of a native `<button>`?

options.t: (A) 沒有缺失，只要 CSS 樣式設定正確，`div` 與 `button` 行為一致。
options.en: (A) None. As long as the CSS is correct, a `div` behaves exactly like a `button`.

options.t: (B) 缺失了預設的 Hover 樣式與 Cursor 指標。
options.en: (B) It lacks default Hover styles and the Cursor pointer.

options.t: (C) 缺失了鍵盤焦點 (Focus)、Role 宣告以及 Enter/Space 鍵的觸發支援。
options.en: (C) It lacks keyboard focusability, Role declaration, and support for Enter/Space key activation.

options.t: (D) 缺失了 SEO 權重，搜尋引擎無法索引 `div` 中的文字。
options.en: (D) It lacks SEO weight; search engines cannot index text inside a `div`.

why.t: 這是經典的 'Clickable Div' 反模式。原生 `<button>` 內建了 `tabindex` (可聚焦)、`role="button"` (語意) 以及鍵盤事件監聽 (Enter 與 Space 鍵觸發 click)。若使用 `div`，開發者必須手動實作上述所有功能，這違反了 'Native First' 原則。
why.en: This is the classic 'Clickable Div' anti-pattern. Native `<button>` elements come with built-in `tabindex` (focusable), `role="button"` (semantics), and keyboard event listeners (Enter and Space keys trigger click). Using a `div` requires developers to manually implement all these features, violating the 'Native First' rule.

question.t: 你正在實作一個模態對話框 (Modal Dialog)。當 Modal 開啟時，使用者按下 `Tab` 鍵，焦點卻移動到了 Modal 背後的頁面 Footer 連結。這違反了哪一項 Modal 的核心互動契約？
question.en: You are implementing a Modal Dialog. When the Modal is open and the user presses the `Tab` key, the focus moves to a footer link on the page behind the Modal. Which core interaction contract of a Modal does this violate?

why.t: Modal 必須限制使用者的操作範圍在對話框內，這稱為 'Focus Trap'。如果焦點能跳出 Modal 進入背景頁面，視障使用者會迷失方向，且誤以為 Modal 已關閉。背景內容應透過 `aria-hidden="true"` 或 `inert` 屬性暫時屏蔽。
why.en: A Modal must constrain user interaction within the dialog box, known as a 'Focus Trap'. If focus escapes the Modal to the background page, visually impaired users may get disoriented and mistakenly believe the Modal has closed. Background content should be temporarily masked using `aria-hidden="true"` or the `inert` attribute.

question.t: 設計師要求一個只有圖示 (Icon) 的「設定」按鈕，視覺上不能有文字。為了確保螢幕閱讀器 (Screen Reader) 能讀出「設定」，你應該使用哪種 CSS 技術？
question.en: The designer requests an icon-only 'Settings' button with no visible text. To ensure Screen Readers can announce 'Settings', which CSS technique should you use?

options.t: (A) 使用 `display: none` 將文字隱藏。
options.en: (A) Use `display: none` to hide the text.

options.t: (B) 使用 `visibility: hidden` 將文字隱藏。
options.en: (B) Use `visibility: hidden` to hide the text.

options.t: (C) 使用 `width: 0; height: 0;` 將文字縮小至消失。
options.en: (C) Use `width: 0; height: 0;` to shrink the text until it disappears.

options.t: (D) 使用 `.sr-only` 類別 (利用 `clip` 或 `absolute` 定位移出可視範圍) 保留 DOM 結構。
options.en: (D) Use an `.sr-only` class (using `clip` or `absolute` positioning to move it out of the viewport) to keep it in the DOM.

why.t: `display: none` 與 `visibility: hidden` 會同時對視覺與輔助科技隱藏內容。正確做法是使用 `.sr-only` (Visually Hidden) 模式，將文字保留在 DOM 中供螢幕閱讀器讀取，但透過 CSS 將其移出視覺範圍。
why.en: `display: none` and `visibility: hidden` hide content from both visual users and assistive technologies. The correct approach is to use the `.sr-only` (Visually Hidden) pattern, keeping the text in the DOM for screen readers while using CSS to move it out of the visual viewport.

question.t: 根據 WAI-ARIA 的 Tabs (分頁籤) 設計模式，當焦點位於某個 Tab 標籤 (Tab Header) 上時，按下 `Tab` 鍵的正確行為應該是什麼？
question.en: According to the WAI-ARIA Tabs design pattern, what is the correct behavior when the `Tab` key is pressed while focus is on a Tab Header?

options.t: (A) 移動焦點到下一個 Tab 標籤。
options.en: (A) Move focus to the next Tab Header.

options.t: (B) 移動焦點到當前選中的 Tab Panel (內容區塊) 內部。
options.en: (B) Move focus into the currently selected Tab Panel (content area).

options.t: (C) 切換選中下一個 Tab 並同時移動焦點。
options.en: (C) Select the next Tab and move focus simultaneously.

options.t: (D) 跳出整個 Tabs 元件，移動到頁面下一個可互動元素。
options.en: (D) Exit the entire Tabs component and move to the next interactive element on the page.

why.t: 這是 Tabs 模式常被誤解的地方。在 Tab List 中，切換標籤應使用 `左右方向鍵 (Arrow Keys)`。`Tab` 鍵的功能是「離開」當前的 Tab List，通常是進入對應的 Panel 內容。若按 Tab 鍵只是切換到下一個標籤，使用者將被迫按多次 Tab 才能讀取內容。
why.en: This is the common misunderstanding of the Tabs pattern. Within a Tab List, switching tabs should be done using `Left/Right Arrow Keys`. The `Tab` key serves to 'exit' the current Tab List, typically moving into the corresponding Panel content. If the Tab key only switches to the next header, users are forced to press Tab many times just to reach the content.

question.t: 你正在開發一個手風琴 (Accordion) 或下拉選單 (Dropdown) 元件。為了讓螢幕閱讀器知道內容目前是「展開」還是「收合」，你必須在 Trigger 按鈕上動態切換哪個 ARIA 屬性？
question.en: You are building an Accordion or Dropdown component. To let screen readers know whether the content is currently 'expanded' or 'collapsed', which ARIA attribute must you dynamically toggle on the Trigger button?

why.t: `aria-expanded="true/false"` 是 Disclosure Pattern (折疊/展開模式) 的核心屬性，用於告知使用者控制項的當前狀態。`aria-hidden` 通常用於內容區塊本身，而 `aria-selected` 用於 Tabs 或 Grid 等選擇項目。
why.en: `aria-expanded="true/false"` is the core attribute of the Disclosure Pattern, used to inform users of the control's current state. `aria-hidden` is typically used on the content block itself, while `aria-selected` is used for selection items like Tabs or Grids.

question.t: 在設計導航列時，有一個「登入」項目，點擊後會彈出一個 Modal 視窗讓使用者輸入帳號密碼，而不會跳轉頁面。這個項目在 HTML 中應該使用什麼標籤？
question.en: In a navigation bar, there is a 'Log In' item. Clicking it opens a Modal window for credentials without navigating to a new page. Which HTML tag should be used for this item?

options.en: (A) <a href="#">, because it looks like a link.

options.t: (B) <button>，因為它觸發的是頁面內的動作 (Action)，而非導航 (Navigation)。
options.en: (B) <button>, because it triggers an in-page Action, not Navigation.

options.t: (C) <div role="link">，為了避免預設樣式干擾。
options.en: (C) <div role="link">, to avoid default style interference.
(D) <span onclick="...">, this is the most lightweight approach.

why.t: 這是 Button vs Link 的經典區分。`<a>` 用於改變 URL 或導航；`<button>` 用於執行腳本動作（如打開 Modal、提交表單）。即使設計樣式像文字連結，若行為是「打開 Modal」，語意上它就是一個按鈕。
why.en: This is the classic distinction between Button and Link. `<a>` is for changing URLs or navigation; `<button>` is for executing script actions (like opening a Modal or submitting a form). Even if it is styled like a text link, if the behavior is 'opening a Modal', it is semantically a button.

question.t: 為了滿足設計需求，開發者使用了上述 CSS 來移除瀏覽器預設的藍色對焦框，但這導致鍵盤使用者無法確認當前焦點位置。
question.en: To meet design requirements, a developer used the CSS above to remove the browser's default blue focus ring, but this makes it impossible for keyboard users to see the current focus location.

question.t: 若希望只在「使用鍵盤導航」時顯示對焦框，而在滑鼠點擊時保持隱藏，應該使用哪一個 CSS 偽類 (Pseudo-class) 來取代單純的 `:focus`？
question.en: If you want to show the focus ring only when 'navigating by keyboard' while keeping it hidden on mouse clicks, which CSS pseudo-class should be used instead of plain `:focus`?

why.t: `:focus-visible` 是現代瀏覽器支援的標準屬性，它允許瀏覽器根據使用者的輸入方式（如鍵盤 vs 滑鼠）來決定是否顯示焦點樣式，從而解決了設計美觀與無障礙之間的衝突。
why.en: `:focus-visible` is a standard property supported by modern browsers that allows the browser to decide whether to apply focus styles based on the user's input method (e.g., keyboard vs. mouse), resolving the conflict between aesthetics and accessibility.

question.t: 在處理表單驗證時，雖然錯誤訊息在視覺上顯示在輸入框下方，但螢幕閱讀器在焦點進入 `input` 時可能不會自動朗讀該錯誤。
question.en: When handling form validation, although the error message is visually displayed below the input, screen readers may not automatically announce the error when focus enters the `input`.

question.t: 為了建立程式碼層級的關聯，你應該在 `<input>` 標籤上加入什麼屬性來指向錯誤訊息的 ID？
question.en: To establish a programmatic association, what attribute should you add to the `<input>` tag to point to the ID of the error message?

why.t: `aria-describedby` 用於提供額外的描述資訊（如錯誤訊息或說明文字），它會與 Label 一起被朗讀；而 `aria-labelledby` 通常用於取代 Label，這可能會導致原本的 Label 被覆蓋。
why.en: `aria-describedby` is used to provide additional descriptive information (such as error messages or help text), which is announced along with the Label; whereas `aria-labelledby` is typically used to replace the Label, which might cause the original Label to be overridden.

question.t: 請檢視上述 HTML 程式碼。從無障礙最佳實務（Best Practices）的角度來看，這段程式碼主要犯了什麼錯誤？
question.en: Please review the HTML code above. From the perspective of accessibility best practices, what is the main mistake in this code?

options.t: (A) 使用了無效的 ARIA role
(D) button 標籤不應放在 nav 內
options.en: (D) The button tag should not be placed inside nav

why.t: HTML5 的 `<nav>` 與 `<button>` 標籤已經隱含了 `role="navigation"` 與 `role="button"`。
why.en: HTML5 `<nav>` and `<button>` tags already have implicit `role="navigation"` and `role="button"`.

why_extended.t: 顯式宣告預設語意是多餘的，會增加程式碼雜訊，屬於「冗餘 ARIA」的反模式。
why_extended.en: Explicitly declaring default semantics is unnecessary, adds noise to the code, and is considered a 'Redundant ARIA' anti-pattern.

question.t: 你正在實作一個按鈕，其中包含一個「加號」圖示與文字 "Add Item"。
question.en: You are implementing a button that contains a 'plus' icon and the text 'Add Item'.

question.t: 由於按鈕文字已經清楚說明了功能，該圖示屬於裝飾性質。為了避免螢幕閱讀器讀出多餘資訊，`` 的 `alt` 屬性應該如何設定？
question.en: Since the button text already clearly explains the function, the icon is decorative. To avoid screen readers announcing redundant information, how should the `alt` attribute of the `` be set?

options.t: (D) 完全移除 alt 屬性

why.t: 將 `alt` 設為空字串 (`alt=""`) 會告訴螢幕閱讀器忽略此圖片。若完全移除 `alt` 屬性，某些螢幕閱讀器可能會讀出圖片的檔名，造成干擾。
why.en: Setting `alt` to an empty string (`alt=""`) tells screen readers to ignore the image. If the `alt` attribute is removed entirely, some screen readers might read the image filename, causing distraction.

question.t: 你實作了一個 Modal，並成功限制了 `Tab` 鍵的焦點循環 (Focus Trap)。
question.en: You implemented a Modal and successfully constrained the `Tab` key focus cycle (Focus Trap).

question.t: 然而，測試發現使用螢幕閱讀器的「虛擬游標 (Virtual Cursor / Reading Mode)」仍然可以閱讀到 Modal 背後的頁面內容。
question.en: However, testing revealed that users using a screen reader's 'Virtual Cursor' (Reading Mode) can still read the page content behind the Modal.

question.t: 為了徹底隔離背景內容，你應該對 Modal 以外的容器應用什麼屬性？
question.en: To completely isolate the background content, what attribute should you apply to the containers outside the Modal?

why.t: `tabindex="-1"` 僅移除互動焦點，但螢幕閱讀器仍可閱讀文字。`aria-hidden="true"` 或 `inert` 屬性才能確保該區域對輔助科技完全隱藏。
why.en: `tabindex="-1"` only removes interactive focus, but screen readers can still read the text. `aria-hidden="true"` or the `inert` attribute ensures the area is completely hidden from assistive technologies.

question.t: 根據無障礙名稱計算 (Accessible Name Calculation) 的優先順序，當螢幕閱讀器聚焦於上述按鈕時，會朗讀什麼內容？
question.en: According to the priority of Accessible Name Calculation, what will be announced when a screen reader focuses on the button above?

why.t: `aria-label` 的優先級高於元素的內部文字內容。當存在 `aria-label` 時，螢幕閱讀器會使用它作為該元件的 Accessible Name，並完全忽略內部的 "X"。
why.en: `aria-label` has higher priority than the element's inner text content. When `aria-label` is present, the screen reader uses it as the component's Accessible Name and completely ignores the inner 'X'.
